description: Copies the selected pages into one new PDF, in page order, named with -pages. Writes the result as a new file next to the input (or to output_path) and never replaces an existing file; the input is left unchanged.

output_path.description: Optional absolute path for the new PDF, ending in .pdf. It must not exist yet. By default the result goes next to the input.

pages.description: Pages, such as "2", "1-3, 5" or "4-end". Commas separate parts.

path.description: Absolute path to a PDF file, or one starting with ~/.

name: extract_pages

output_path.description: Where the new PDF was written

title: Extract pages
